website.readmeExcerpt:
# RE:Frame XIV

A seamless, adaptive replacement HUD for Final Fantasy XIV.

RE:Frame XIV reshapes the game interface around what you are doing, keeping important information visible when it matters while reducing unnecessary screen clutter during quieter moments.

## Installation

Add the following URL as a custom plugin repository in Dalamud:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rubyblaire/RE-Frame/main/pluginmaster.json
```

Then search for **RE:Frame XIV** in the Dalamud Plugin Installer.

## Commands

```text
/reframe 	- Opens the RE:Frame configuration window.
/ref      	- Opens the RE:Frame configuration window.
/ref edit 	- Opens the RE:Frame edit window.
/ref bars 	- Opens the RE:Frame action bars window.
/ref keybinds   - Opens the RE:Frame keybinds window.
```

## Current Release

**Version 0.4.0.65**  
**Dalamud API Level 15**

## Support and Feedback

Issues and feedback can be submitted through the discord: 
```text
https://discord.gg/Dr836dmbqh
```

## Author

Created by **Ruby Blaire**.
